title: Skyvern (YC S23) Is Hiring Open-Source Loving DevRel Engineers
summary: Skyvern, a Y Combinator Summer 2023 backed company, is hiring founding Developer Relations engineers passionate about open-source and AI. The position focuses on developer marketing and building community around their open-source AI products.
problem_solved: Helps developers find career opportunities in DevRel roles focused on open-source AI development and community building.
why_valuable: Provides an opportunity to join a YC-backed AI company as a founding DevRel engineer, building developer community from the ground up.
